tools.name: verify_text
tools.description: Claim-by-claim hallucination verification. Input text is split into claims, and each claim is verified (supported / refuted / unverified) with source citations. Returns a red/yellow/green summary plus each claim's status, confidence, reason and sources, along with citations and quota. Consumes detec

tools.name: verify_agent
tools.description: Agent output and trajectory self-check. Runs claim-by-claim hallucination verification on the final answer and a six-dimension structured evaluation of the execution trajectory (factuality, sourcing, instruction compliance, tool-claim consistency, task completion, reflection). Returns main.claims, s

tools.name: check_cua_actions
tools.description: Computer-Use Agent action risk grading. Submit an action trajectory and receive a step-by-step verdict of L0 (allow) / L1 (allow + log) / L2 (require confirmation) / L3 (block) / takeover (suspend in credential scenarios and wait for the user to type manually), together with matched_rules, outcome a

tools.name: check_cua_code_audit
tools.description: CUA code audit: static analysis of agent source code that detects dangerous imports (subprocess, os.system, and similar), privilege boundaries (eval/exec), injection surface (string-concatenated shell commands), dangerous defaults, and missing sandboxing. Pure rule-based scanning: no LLM calls, no q

tools.name: check_safety
tools.description: AI safety gateway detection. Runs three-layer OWASP LLM Top 10 detection on prompt + output: a 40+ signature rule engine (injection, jailbreak, harmful content, sensitive data leakage, fraud) plus optional LLM deep analysis and optional hallucination detection. Returns passed, risk_score, risk_level

tools.name: check_agent_ice_wall
tools.description: Agent ice wall (child lock / fuse). Call it once before every agent step for per-step hallucination guardrails plus session-level cumulative risk fusing. The response's action field is the only one you need to read: allow/warn = proceed, block = this step is intercepted, frozen = halt the entire run

tools.name: reset_agent_ice_wall
tools.description: Manually unfreeze an agent session frozen by the ice wall (call after the user confirms it is safe). was_frozen=false means the session was not frozen in the first place (idempotent). The risk score resets to zero after unfreezing.
